title: Typical out-of-pocket IVF cost: one cycle vs. a full attempt (dollars)

source.name: Fertility clinic cost surveys (widely reported range from FertilityIQ, Mayo Clinic and clinic price transparency data)

notes: A single IVF cycle (with medications) typically runs about $20,000 out of pocket; most patients need more than one cycle, putting a typical full attempt closer to $50,000.
